impl.summary: DBS D3, open engine only. Owner rule: samAudioCloud is false (docs/handoff/owner-decisions.json), so the brief's cloud SAM Audio pass, the 'Background split: SAM Audio / Demucs' setting and the SAM prices were left out. The cloud dub is unchanged: extract + Demucs, three beds, the voice-only fallback (OPTIONAL_PREPARE) and ElevenLabs isolation. On the open engine, Translate & dub has a new 'Voice split' setting. MelBand RoFormer stays the default until D4 reports. The other choice is DBS, which keeps the music, effects and singing in the background and does its split on a CPU. DBS runs through the new graph B dub-prepare-dbs-transcribe and the ModelDef oss-dbs-voice-separate 'DBS + Qwen3-ASR'. Graph B was validated on the live CPU ComfyUI and run for real on a 12 s clip.
built: Graph B scripts/comfy/hand-built/dub-prepare-dbs-transcribe.json, with its spec entry next to dub-prepare-separate-transcribe. Nodes: LoadAudio, DBSLoader (separationModel), DBSSeparate (mono, input rate), and AudioMerge subtract to make the background. Voice and background are saved as FLAC. Node 7 is the MelBand graph's Qwen3-ASR node with its settings and bindings (sourceLanguage, asrModel, hints, maxChars). Same outputs as the MelBand graph: voice, background, cues, transcript, language. vramGb 8, the existing autoDownloads note and the licence text from the brief. Both DBS models are required, as in graph A. Built with npm run build, then manifest header restored and the BSRNN config size set to 0 like graph A. requirements.json rebuilt with both packs and the four DBS files. Both packs were already pinned in packs.json and the DBS files in model-pins.json, so neither file changed. validate-workflows --shared passed and set validated: true. object_info.subset.json restored because it already had every class.

Provider (src/server/providers/comfyui.ts): a DBS graph with no channels binding still gets the surround rule. A source with more than 2 channels has node 4 rewired to music + effects (dbsSurroundBed). The host pick of DBS model and the refusal of a model that isn't installed apply to graph B as they do to graph A.
Catalog: oss-dbs-voice-separate 'DBS + Qwen3-ASR' next to oss-voice-separate. Its licence row comes from the workflow licence.

src/lib/av/dub.ts: VOICE_SPLITS (melband/dbs with model id, name and note), DEFAULT_VOICE_SPLIT 'melband', voiceSplitModel() and MUSIC_MODEL_NOTE. PrepareInput.voiceSplit picks the open first step's model; DUB_STEP_MODELS.open.stems stays the default. DubSession.voiceSplit is stored for open step dubs only.

Server and API: CreateDubInput.voiceSplit goes through createDubSession and previewDub. The POST /api/dub schema takes voiceSplit (melband|dbs); anything else gets 400 'Check the dub settings'. No new route, and the public sign-up rules are unchanged: /api/dub was already in EMPTY_LISTS and PREVIEWS, and a visitor's run is still refused own-gpu-tool. The dub studio already showed visitors the SelfHostNote, 'Self-hosted only' in place of the price and an inert upload, the same pattern D2 used.

Assist: dub_video takes voice_split (melband|dbs, open source only, described in the schema). Both the studio route (dubJob/prepareProblem) and the fallback pipeline (dubSteps) use it. Recipes keep a dub's voice_split (recipe-builder liftStudio).

UI (src/components/dub/dub-studio.tsx): on the open engine in step mode, a 'Voice split' Select offers 'DBS: keeps music and effects, CPU-friendly' and 'MelBand RoFormer'. A choice switched off in Settings → Models & licences is left out. Under it is the note: DBS 'Keeps the music and sound effects of the original.', MelBand 'Music model: some sound effects may be lowered, and singing may be replaced.' The route line follows the choice. On the cloud: 'Music and effects: Demucs. Music model: some sound effects may be lowered, and singing may be replaced.' The price line is unchanged (Free on your GPU / Placeholder · free on the open engine).
Docs: scripts/comfy/README.md has a graph B section; docs/research/dbs-separation-7.md has 'As built (D3)' notes in §4.4 graph B and §9 D3 (a research correction).
impl.tests: New tests/comfy-dbs-dub.test.ts (9 tests): graph B's manifest outputs and bindings match dub-prepare-separate-transcribe's, plus separationModel; packs, models and licence; the requirement-index row; the graph matches graph A's split and keeps node 7's settings unchanged; the provider fills the host pick, the ASR model, the filename prefixes and the surround rewire, and refuses a missing model; output order. Extended tests/av-dub.test.ts: prepareSteps per engine and voice split; the cloud is unchanged with voiceSplit (Demucs, three loudnorm beds, OPTIONAL_PREPARE, no sam-audio-separate model); a demo DBS dub where the mock returns voice, background and cues, then reaches review and mixes over the bed; open prices are free with either split. Also extended: assist-context (fallback with voice_split), assist-studio-routes (dub_video with voice_split dbs; the /api/dub price check accepts dbs and refuses 'sam'), recipe-builder (voice_split kept). Typecheck clean. ESLint clean on the changed files apart from one existing warning in library.spec.mjs. Full Vitest (--maxWorkers=2): 283 files, 4517 passed, 3 skipped, 1 failed. The failure is tests/gpu-api.test.ts '409 gpu-setup', which got 503 because the shared disk had 17-18 GB free against the 20 GB account guard (FUOBE_ACCOUNT_DISK_FREE_GB). With FUOBE_ACCOUNT_DISK_FREE_GB=1 that file passes 12/12; this is the environment, not this change. Live ComfyUI: graph B validated with validate-workflows --shared, then run for real through Fuobe (pnpm dev, COMFYUI_URL=127.0.0.1:8188, POST /api/generations on oss-dbs-voice-separate, asrModel Qwen3-ASR 0.6B) on a 12 s H.264+AAC clip of LibriSpeech speech over sine chords and pink-noise bursts. It succeeded in 133 s on the CPU, including the ASR load. Voice + background equal the decoded source within 3.0e-5, the voice stem is about 17.9 dB SNR against the true speech, the bed about 11.2 dB, and the transcript and cues were right ('He hoped there would be stew for dinner, …'). Browser: new tests/e2e/dub-voice-split.mjs, demo mode, 1440 and 390 px, light and dark, all 41 checks passed. It covers the Voice split and its default, both notes, the route line, the price line, the cloud's Demucs note with no Voice split, no sideways scroll, and a DBS dub's first step running on 'DBS + Qwen3-ASR'. Dev server stopped and .next deleted.
left: Cloud half (one SAM Audio 'speech' pass in place of extract + Demucs, the Background split setting, SAM prices): not built because samAudioCloud is false. It waits on the owner.
Not run here: the 1.7B ASR default (only 0.6B, as the brief allowed); a whole open dub with DBS (local LLM translation, Chatterbox, InfiniteTalk); GPU timing; listening tests of dub quality.
The default stays MelBand until D4's A/B; flipping it is a one-line change to DEFAULT_VOICE_SPLIT.
No /connect board row for Translate & dub: no row existed before, and dubs don't run on an account's GPU (own-gpu-tool). Graph B is in requirements.json.
impl.docsNotes: Already there from earlier packages (D1/D2): ComfyUI-DBS pinned and the four DBS weight files on the ComfyUI; the mock already returned voice, background and cues for any separate-audio endpoint containing 'transcribe'; the dub studio's visitor pattern (SelfHostNote, 'Self-hosted only', inert upload). Brief out of date on line numbers: the spec entry is at library.spec.mjs about L2944 (not L2239-2262), oss-voice-separate at models.ts about L1396 (not L1113), Assist's open dub at studio-tools.ts about L234, which still holds. For the docs pass: ARCHITECTURE could say Translate & dub's open first step has a Voice split (MelBand default, DBS via dub-prepare-dbs-transcribe on oss-dbs-voice-separate) and that the provider's surround bed rule covers graph B. STATUS could count one more hand-built graph (182 workflows in the manifest; graph B validated). FEATURES/README could mention 'Keeps the music and sound effects of the original' on the open engine. In demo mode, e2e scripts must use http://localhost:<port>, not 127.0.0.1: Next 16 dev blocks /_next resources and the HMR socket from 127.0.0.1, so the page never hydrates.

findings.title: On the cloud engine, the studio never says that keeping the music and effects (DBS) runs on your GPU (open source)
findings.where: src/components/dub/dub-studio.tsx (the cloud note, around L251: 'Music and effects: Demucs. Music model: ...'); tests/e2e/dub-voice-split.mjs L70-77
findings.detail: The brief says that with samAudioCloud=false, 'the feature says it runs on your GPU, open source'. The owner's rule (10-30) also asks the UI to say plainly what each engine does. With the cloud picked, the dub studio shows only the Demucs caveat and no Voice split. Nothing tells the user that 'Keeps the music and sound effects of the original' (DBS) is offered on the open engine. Leaving out the cloud SAM route is correct. This is only a missing line of copy.
findings.verified: Traced the JSX: the cloud branch renders only MUSIC_MODEL_NOTE. The e2e cloud checks assert the Demucs note and that no combobox is shown, nothing more.
findings.fix: Add a short line under the cloud note, such as 'Keeping the music and sound effects of the original (DBS) runs on your GPU (open source).', and assert it in the e2e script.

findings.title: The server's default voice split ignores Settings → Models & licences, unlike the studio
findings.where: src/lib/av/dub.ts voiceSplitModel(); src/server/assist/studio-routes.ts dubJob/prepareProblem; src/server/assist/studio-tools.ts dubSteps
findings.detail: The studio drops a split that is switched off with keepOffered/offered, so with MelBand RoFormer off it sends voiceSplit 'dbs'. On the server, voiceSplitModel() always falls back to DEFAULT_VOICE_SPLIT. So an Assist dub_video call without voice_split, or POST /api/dub without voiceSplit, plans oss-voice-separate even when it is off and DBS is on. prepareProblem only checks routes (chooseRoute), not access. The plan card looks fine, then generations.prepare refuses the run as switched off. This is not unsafe and not a regression (before D3 there was no alternative), but the two defaults now disagree.
findings.verified: Read voiceSplitModel, dubJob/prepareProblem (route check only), keepOffered/offered in src/lib/model-access.ts, and the switched-off refusal in src/server/generations.ts prepare() at L646.
findings.fix: Choose the server default with firstOffered/isOffered over [DEFAULT_VOICE_SPLIT, ...rest] for the open engine, in prepareSteps' callers or in voiceSplitModel with an access callback.

findings.title: VOICE_SPLITS' doc comment is stranded above MUSIC_MODEL_NOTE's
findings.detail: The /** The open engine's voice split ... */ block is followed straight away by a second /** */ block for MUSIC_MODEL_NOTE. Editors and TSDoc attach only the second one, so VOICE_SPLITS has no doc.
findings.fix: Move the VOICE_SPLITS comment down to the line above `export const VOICE_SPLITS`.
